title: API Security Fundamentals
content: API security includes authentication, authorization, input validation, and rate limiting to protect endpoints from malicious attacks.

title: Cloud Infrastructure Overview
content: Cloud infrastructure provides scalable computing, storage, networking, and managed services on demand via platforms like AWS and GCP.

title: Introduction to Machine Learning
content: Machine learning is a subset of artificial intelligence that enables systems to learn and improve from data without being explicitly programmed.

title: Generative AI and LLMs
content: Generative AI models, such as large language models, use deep learning to generate human-like text, code, and multimedia content.

title: Database Management Systems
content: Relational and non-relational database management systems ensure efficient data storage, retrieval, indexing, and transaction safety.

title: DevOps Practices and CI/CD
content: DevOps bridges software development and IT operations through continuous integration, automated testing, and continuous deployment.

title: Automated Software Testing
content: Automated testing executes predefined unit, integration, and end-to-end test suites to verify software behavior and prevent regressions.

title: Cybersecurity Best Practices
content: Robust cybersecurity involves multi-factor authentication, regular vulnerability assessments, encryption at rest, and secure coding standards.

title: Data Engineering Pipelines
content: Data engineering focuses on building scalable pipelines for data extraction, transformation, loading (ETL), and stream processing.

title: Microservices Architecture
content: Microservices architecture structures an application as a collection of loosely coupled, independently deployable services communicating over APIs.

title: Containerization with Docker
content: Docker containers package software code and all its dependencies together so applications run reliably across different computing environments.

title: Kubernetes Orchestration
content: Kubernetes automates deployment, scaling, and management of containerized applications across clusters of host servers.

title: Version Control with Git
content: Git is a distributed version control system that tracks changes in source code during software development, enabling team collaboration.

title: Asynchronous Programming in Python
content: Python asyncio module enables writing concurrent code using async and await syntax, ideal for handling high-throughput network I/O operations.

title: FastAPI Web Framework
content: FastAPI is a modern, high-performance web framework for building APIs with Python based on standard type hints and automatic OpenAPI documentation.

title: Vector Embeddings in AI
content: Vector embeddings convert unstructured text, images, or audio into dense numerical arrays that capture semantic meaning for similarity search.

title: Cosine Similarity Mathematics
content: Cosine similarity measures the cosine of the angle between two multi-dimensional vectors to determine how directionally aligned their meanings are.

title: RESTful API Design Principles
content: REST architecture uses standard HTTP methods like GET, POST, PUT, and DELETE with stateless client-server communication and resource-based URLs.

title: SQL vs NoSQL Databases
content: SQL databases provide structured tables with ACID guarantees, while NoSQL databases offer flexible schemas designed for horizontal scalability.

title: Software Error Handling and Logging
content: Proper error handling, custom exceptions, and structured logging ensure applications fail gracefully and provide actionable debugging insights.
